text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening claim: \"I'll name all the reasons self-controlled cars should be brought into our lives\"","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"It states a recognizable position early and tells the reader what the essay will argue."},{"evidence":"uses article details like \"half a million miles without a crash\" and cars that \"alert the driver to take over\"","quality":"source use","description":"It draws on specific information from the article to support its claims rather than relying mostly on opinion."},{"evidence":"paragraphs on safety, convenience, and reduced accidents","quality":"idea development","description":"It develops several reasons in separate sections instead of staying at the level of brief reactions."},{"evidence":"body paragraphs with transitions like \"First\" and \"These cars can change our lives for the better\"","quality":"organization","description":"It follows a more essay-like structure with an introduction, supporting body, and conclusion."},{"evidence":"repeated focus on safety, warnings, and accident prevention","quality":"argument support","description":"It gives the argument more sustained backing by connecting the article’s evidence to the writer’s pro-driverless position."}]}
